|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Vader's Custom TIE (V)]] (version 3 of 3); it is the current text. The image here is the Players Committee card image ([[:File:V6-D-Vaders_Custom_TIE_(V)-2024-04-22-eb9f1e8.gif]]). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; bracketed names such as [Episode VII] stand for icons printed on the cards, and ▲ is the card's icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[Vader's Custom TIE (V)]]): Virtual Set 6 release ([[Virtual Set 6]]); Players Committee card image<ref name="ht0">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/vaderscustomtie.gif vaderscustomtie.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit 022435b "Set 9 load", 8 July 2018.</ref>. Margin “•Vader’s Custom TIE”: “May add 1 pilot. Non-[Virtual Set 0] Vader deploys -2 aboard. While Vader piloting, immune to attrition < 5 and once per battle, may cancel game text of opponent's pilot aboard a starfighter here.” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Vader's Custom TIE (V) (Errata)]]): Players Committee card image, marked “E”<ref name="ht1">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/vaderscustomtie.gif vaderscustomtie.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit a5142dd "Tweak set images", 12 May 2020.</ref>: “May add 1 pilot. Vader deploys -2 aboard. While Vader piloting, immune to attrition < 5, and during battle, may cancel game text of a passenger (or pilot of ability < 4) here.” '''What changed:''' “Non-[Virtual Set 0] Vader” became “Vader”; “immune to attrition &lt; 5 and once per battle, may cancel game text of opponent's pilot aboard a starfighter here” became “immune to attrition &lt; 5, and during battle, may cancel game text of a passenger (or pilot of ability &lt; 4) here”; the margin lost its dot. No errata sheet has been found; the commit date, 12 May 2020, is the earliest proven date. Before/after: [[File:V6-D-Vaders_Custom_TIE_(V)-compare-022435b-a5142dd.png|440px]]
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image, marked “E1”<ref name="ht2">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/eb9f1e88dd679e4fa7860bc7cc8b6032d3476e13/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/vaderscustomtie.gif vaderscustomtie.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit eb9f1e8 "V6 Remaster Part 2", 22 April 2024.</ref>: “May add 1 pilot. Vader deploys -2 aboard. While Vader piloting, immune to attrition < 5 and, during battle, may cancel game text of a passenger (or pilot of ability < 4) here.” '''What changed:''' the comma moved: “attrition &lt; 5, and during battle,” became “attrition &lt; 5 and, during battle,”; the card was remastered and the errata mark became “E1”. The card prints the errata mark “E1” although this is change 2 in release order: a PC transcription error in the mark (Bill, 12 November 2026: number versions by release order and record the printed mark). This is the current text. Before/after: [[File:V6-D-Vaders_Custom_TIE_(V)-compare-a5142dd-eb9f1e8.png|440px]]
